بما جعله في دائرة الإمكان، وأقام عليه دلائلَ الكون وسننَ الوجود. فالتكليفُ تابعٌ للإمكان، والحكمُ يدورُ مع علَّته وجودًا وعدمًا. ومن سُنَّةِ الله في خلقه أنَّ الهلالَ له أطوارٌ وأحوال، يُرى في زمنٍ، ويستحيلُ أن يُرى في زمنٍ آخر بحسب السنن الكونية الجارية التي لا تتبدل ولا تتحول. فمتى قامت القرائنُ القطعية، أو أجمعتِ المعرفةُ الفلكيةُ المعتبرة على استحالة رؤيته في وقتٍ ما، كان ادعاءُ رؤيته في ذلك الظرف مظنَّةَ الريبة، ومثارَ التوقُّف، إذ الشرعُ لا يبنى على ما يُناقض الحقائقَ الثابتة والسننَ الجارية. وقد جاء عن أئمةِ المذهب ما يدلُّ على اعتبار هذه المعاني؛ فقد قال أبو بكر: روى ابنُ وضّاح عن سحنون في عدلين شهدا في الهلال والسماءُ صاحيةٌ ولا يشهد غيرُهما، فقال: «وأيُّ ريبةٍ أكبرُ من هذا!!». فجعل تفرُّدَهما بالشهادة مع صفاءِ السماء مظنَّةَ ريبةٍ ظاهرة، لأنَّ الصحوَ البيِّنَ يقتضي في العادة أن يشترك الناسُ في الرؤية، ولا ينفرد بها اثنان دون سائر الخلق. وجاء في «النوادر والزيادات»: أخبر أبو بكر قال لنا يحيى بن عمر: ويجوز عندي شهادةُ رجلين في الصحو في الصوم والفطر. قال غيره من أصحابنا: ومعنى قول سحنون هذا في المِصر الكبير العظيم. والصحوُ: البيِّنُ، أنه يبعُد أن يتفرّد هذان برؤيته، ويُقدَح بذلك ريبةٌ في شهادتهما. ومعناه ـ على وجه الإجمال ـ أنَّه إذا شهد شاهدان برؤية الهلال والسماءُ صحوٌ، فالأصلُ أنَّ شهادتهما أبعدُ من أن تكون خاطئة، إذ الغالبُ أن يراه غيرُهما معهما، ويبعُد أن يُعرِّضا شهادتهما للقدح بأن ينفردا بما لم يشهد به الناس، لأنهما يعلمان أن الخطأ أو الكذب في مثل هذه الحال، مع صفاءِ السماء، موجبٌ للطعن في عدالتهما وإسقاط شهادتهما. فالشاهدُ أنَّ التفرُّد بالشهادة بالرؤية من دون الناس في الصحو قد يُعتبر قدحًا في الشهادة، لما يلابسه من مظنةِ الوهم أو الغلط. فكيف إذا جاء من يشهد برؤية الهلال سُوَيعاتٍ بعد انقضاء كسوف الشمس، في حالٍ قد أجمع أهلُ الهيئة (الفلكيون) على استحالة رؤية الهلال فيها بالعين المجردة؟! أليس ذلك أولى بالإنكار، وأحقَّ بالتوقُّف، وأجدرَ أن يُرَدَّ إلى ميزان الشرع والعقل وسنن الله الجارية؟! إنَّ الشريعةَ لا تُبنى على الدعاوى المجردة، ولا تُسلِّم بما تُكذِّبه السننُ الكونية القطعية. فالواجبُ أن تُصان العباداتُ عن العبث، وأن يُحتاط لأمر الدين، وأن يُردَّ ما كان مظنَّةَ ريبةٍ إلى أهل العلم والبصيرة، تحقيقًا لقوله تعالى: ﴿فاسألوا أهل الذكر إن كنتم لا تعلمون﴾. والله المستعان، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم."

observer_notes: "On Tuesday 16 March 2010 (29 Rabi-ul Awwal 1431 AH) many people from throughout UK have attempted to sight the youngest crescent moon (Hilal) of Rabi-ul Thani after sunset. People made arrangements to observe from exceptionally high locations with clear western horizons (including Sutton Bank, 1000 ft above sea level). Unfortunately, the 21 hours old Hilal was not sighted, as most places became totally cloudy after sunset. We have not received any reliable sighting news from countries from East of UK either (including negative sighting Morocco). Therefore, the Ulama have decided that the month of Rabi-ul Awwal 1431 AH will have 30 days and the month of Rabi-ul Thani (or Rabi-ul Akhir) 1431 AH will start from Thursday 18 March 2010, Insha-Allah. The Sutton Bank (Thirsk, North Yorkshire) group of 22 observers comprised of the following people. From Manchester: Maulana Samiruddin Qasmi, Mohammad Bhana, Mohammad Bharmgy, Javed Mami and Imran Samir. From Batley: Maulana Hasib Mayet, Maulana Imran Lunat, Ismail Bhai Lunat and Vashiullah Bodiyat. From York: Shaykh Zubair Ahamad, Salim Amira, Meshal Al-Naseer, Mohammad Al-Rahmawy, Dawood Wlikinson, Moin Uddin and Qamar Uddin. Members of York Astronomical Society included: Martin Whipp, Paul Buglass, Martin Whillock, Philip Holmes, Philip Jennings (and his mother, Mrs Jennings)."

observer_notes: "The young crescent could be observed visually from munich, despite a lot of haze in the sky. Crescent age was about 21h and elongation from the sun about 9.7°. The established CCD technique pinpointed the exact location and allowed to search the correct region of the sky visually, after having aligned on the sun and mercury earlier. After some thicker clouds had moved, i could see the crescent visually with a pair of 20x60 binoculars. I could see the crescent visually during its descent for about 20 minutes, till it simply got to dark to see, a very thin, dark-red line. I never saw it with naked eye. The CCD technique showed it for 10 more minutes, all the way to the local horizon, but i had to increase exposure by more than 100x compared to the earlier brightness levels. The haze sure caused a lot of absorption. More images and details on my homepage: http://www.mondatlas.de/other/martinel/sicheln2011/maerz/crescent_20110305.html"

Later, we had a splendid view of the ISS flying by, using our large reflector."

observer_notes: "I observed the old crescent this morning at about 8.8° elongation. The weather was ok, with some haze near the horizon, at -11°C. The seeing was quite bad, which strongly blurred the view of the mountain peaks across the valey where the crescent was due to rize. I tested a combination of inexpensive camera and optics, but found serious issues with the image quality with the crescent repeatedly fading from view. Still, the camera showed the crescent clear enough for about 25 minutes between moonrise and sunrise. I als tried to observe the crescent visually with a small telescope at 60x. Despite being reasonably sure of the position and focus i could NOT spot the crescent visually. I think that the haze and the bad seeing both were responsible for this, plus some problems with the lashed-together instruments. Around noon, we also observed the old crescent with the imaging system at about 7° elongation. The weather was still rather hazy, but the crescent was imaged clearly enough."

observer_notes: "Old Moon Crescent Observation Report ====================================== Observed: Tuesday; February 21, 2012 - 06:36 (Local) Location (WGS 84) = Tucson, Arizona (USA) Longitude = 110.68 W Latitude = 32.40 N Elevation = 2240 meters Time Zone = -7.0 hours Surface conditions at location: Temperature = 2 °C Humidity = 45 % Pressure = 30.10 in. observer_notes: "I arrived at my sighting location at 4:35 pm EST (sunset: 5:07 pm). The western horizon was mostly clear. Using a pair of binoculars (7X50), I started scanning the southwestern horizon. Venus was seen at 4:46 pm by the binocular and then by naked eye at 5:06. The first binocular-sighting of Jupiter was at 5:07 pm. The naked eye sighting was at 5:23 pm, however. My first binocular sighting of the crescent moon was at 5:12 pm. The naked eye sighting was 8 minutes later at 5:20 pm. The horns were at 2:00 and 6:30 O'clock (2:00;4:00;6:30). The binocular sighting of Saturn was at 5:27 pm. Later, I noticed that it was clearly visible by the naked eye at 5:44 pm. I ended the session at 6:04 pm when the moon was very close to the horizon and still faintly visible (moonset: 6:11 pm)."

observer_notes: "Bismillah al Rahman al Rahim. as Salamu alaykum wa rahmatulLah On Friday, November 5, 2021 between 6:25pm-6:30pm Pacific Daylight Time (PDT), I saw the new crescent moon of Rabi ul Thani 1443 by naked eye. I was located just outside of Del Cerro Park in Rancho Palos Verdes, California, USA at WGS84 geographic coordinates of: +33.7587335 Latitude, -118.3690562 Longitude. Sunset at this location was approximately 5:57pm, moonset was approximately 6:47pm and the moon set at an azimuth of approximately 245 degrees. I searched for the moon using a magnetic compass set to the above azimuth and spotted it by eye without the use of any optical aids. Then I was able to see the same crescent through my phone camera and took photos - but the camera quality was too poor to show the thin crescent moon in the photos that were taken. (I will try to get a hold of a better camera to use for future months' sightings.) The sky conditions alternated between clear and overcast - as there was heavy fog just below the horizon - and so there was just a narrow span of about 5 minutes in which I could see the moon before the clouds rose up and obstructed my view of the horizon. Jazakum Allahu khaira was Salam Milad Ali Ershaghi Palos Verdes Estates, CA, USA (Photos are attached to show the sky conditions - but the crescent is not visible in the photos due to the quality of the camera used.)"

observer_notes: "New Moon Crescent Observation Report ====================================== Observed: Tuesday; October 25, 2022 at 17:57 (Local Time) Location (WGS 84): Windy Point, Mt. Lemmon , Arizona (USA) Longitude = 110.7160 W Latitude = 32.3676 N Elevation = 2003 meters Time Zone = -7.0 hours Surface conditions at Mt. Lemmon: Temperature = 65.0 °F Dew Point = 24.6 °F Barometric Pressure = 27.41 inches (sea level) Completely clear sky. One of the best that I’ve seen. Topocentric and local time values from “Accurate Times”: Sunset (at sea level) = 17:47 ..Moonset (at sea level) = 18:06 Time from new moon at 17.55 = .15 hr. 15 min. Moon lag time = . 18 min. Relative Altitude = 3.9 degrees Elongation from sun = 6.9 degrees Crescent width = 7 arc sec Illumination = 0.37 percent Crescent not observed through 8” SC F/10 telescope with 25mm eyepiece: I was not able to use any reference stars or planets (Venus too close to the sun, Arcturus too red?), so I had to off-set from the sun which is never absolutely precise. Consequently, I felt that the crescent was within the field-of-view, but could not be positive that it was centered. Only the usual false crescents showed up, and they teased me by showing up in the same place. None lasted more than two seconds, and my observing partner was never able to confirm any of them. The “teasing” lasted for 20 minutes, but the images never improved as the sky darkened. They also were not consistent with the Moon’s “change in declination” path. Observers: Jim Stamm and Brad Schaefer E-mail Address: [email protected] "

observer_notes: "This evening, I observed the crescent moon marking the beginning of Rabi al-Thani 1448 AH from the rice fields of Jetis, Ponorogo. This time, I mounted a smart telescope on top of the car, allowing greater flexibility in selecting an observing site with a clear western horizon. The crescent was already detectable shortly before sunset. At first, the thin lunar arc appeared extremely faint against the bright twilight sky. As the Sun gradually descended below the horizon, the sky contrast improved and the crescent became increasingly distinct through the telescope. Another striking scene appeared in nearly the same field of view. Directly below the crescent, smoke could be seen rising from a forest fire in the hills of Pacitan, East Java. The evening presented two contrasting faces of nature: the delicate lunar crescent marking the transition into a new Hijri month, and the smoke below reminding us of the fragility of the environment we inhabit. "

observer_notes: "Today, September 12, 2026. I, along with LDII, Muhammadiyah, Nahdlatul Ulama, and the Ngawi Astronomy Club, conducted an observation of the moon crescent . We regularly use Bukit Kerek Indah as the site for our projects. The equipment utilized was as follows: Ngawi Astronomy Club: An imaging refractor (ED 60/330) with a direct sensor system and full spectrum, mounted on a robotic alt-azimuth mount. And Naked eye. LDII: A visual refractor (Celestron 90 Deluxe 93/900) with a 20mm Kellner eyepiece and a 0.5x reducer, mounted on a German Equatorial Mount-2. And finderscope 30x6. We compared various methods for detecting the birth of the new moon for research purposes, utilizing the experience gained to advance scientific understanding. This initiative serves to provide knowledge and education to the general public—a crucial effort, as communities in remote areas are often overlooked regarding such information. Through these hands-on field activities, participants gain a deeper understanding and can share their knowledge of astronomical events with others. In our region, astronomical myths remain deeply ingrained; this positive activity was organized to promote scientific knowledge—prioritizing STEM principles—while remaining grounded in *fiqh* (Islamic jurisprudence), physics, and astrophysics."

observer_notes: "On Tuesday 4 January 2011 (29 Muharram 1432 AH) many people from throughout UK have attempted to sight the crescent moon (Hilal) of Safar after sunset. None of the groups were able to sight the Hilal as most places were cloudy. We have not received any reliable sighting news from countries east of UK/Morocco either. However, we have received negative sighting report from Jamiat-e-Ulama, South Africa. Therefore, the Ulama (including Wifaq/Batley) have decided that the month of Muharram 1432 AH will complete 30 days and the month of Safar 1432 AH will start from Thursday 6 January 2011, Insha-Allah. Note that there was a partial solar eclipse on 4 January 2011, witnessing the New Moon Conjunction with the human eye by many thousands of people from around the world. It is generally not possible to sight the Hilal on the same day of a solar eclipse, after sunset. There is also a Fatwa (legal ruling) from Sheikh Saleh Ibn Othaimeen of Saudi Arabia to this effect."

observer_notes: "I arrived at my sighting location at 6:50 pm EDT (sunset: 7:10 pm). The western horizon was partly cloudy and hazy. Using a pair of binoculars (7X50), I started looking for the crescent in a few openings with no success. At no time these openings overlapped with the moon's position. At 7:47 pm, I decided to drive to a different location to the northwest to position myself with an opening that was hugging the lower horizon. A short time after my arrival, through the pair of binoculars, I could see the setting crescent for a very short time at 7:56 pm. Because of light pollution, the very low altitude of the moon, and perhaps weak eyesight, I was unable to see it with naked eye. I also, could not discern the exact positions of its horns. The crescent was thin and somewhat orange in color. Soon, I could not see it further (moonset: 8:09 pm). If it were not because of the clouds, I could have seen the moon earlier with naked eye."

observer_notes: " arrived at my sighting location at 8:15 pm EDT (apparent sunset: 8:17 pm and actual sunset: 8:21 pm). The western horizon was partly cloudy and extremely hazy. Soon, using a pair of binoculars (7X50), I started looking for the crescent moon. At 8:21 pm, I saw Venus and immediately after I saw the moon to its upper right. Very soon, they were behind a piece of cloud. At 8:32 pm, Venus appeared below the piece of cloud followed by the moon. I could see them till they were covered by another piece of cloud again at 8:58 pm. This time the cloud was extended mostly to the horizon. During the 25 minutes I could clearly see the moon through the pair of binoculars, I attempted naked-eye sighting for a few times with no success. Based on what I can see in the pictures I took, the horns were approximately at 2:30 and 6:30 O'clock (2:30;4:00;6:30). I left the area at around 9:20 pm (moonset: 9:42 pm). "

observer_notes: "On Friday, 25 July 2025, I felt confident that I would be able to sight the moon, but I was also anxious about the lower sky conditions. In the UK, the moon’s altitude at sunset was only +5.50°, and it would appear as a very thin crescent. Three days earlier, I had left home to study clouds and atmospheric conditions directly, and my journey eventually brought me to Selsey, Chichester, UK. From there, I attempted to sight the crescent moon (Hilal) for Safar 1447. The crescent was first observed at 21:13:30 with the help of an optical aid, and I was able to follow it uninterrupted for six minutes until it disappeared into dense conditions on the horizon at 21:19:30. While I was observing, two adults (non-Muslims) were standing next to me on the beach. I invited the first person to look through the optical aid, and she was able to see the moon within seconds. When asked again, she could spot it immediately again. I then asked the second adult to try, but he could not see it. I took another look and noticed the moon was descending toward the horizon and dimming, but I let him try again. Unfortunately, he still couldn’t see it. I looked once more and watched the moon fading rapidly as it sank lower, disappearing completely before my eyes into the denser horizon. Overall, I saw it six times within those six minutes, and two out of three adults managed to view it. Up until then, I had not attempted to take a picture with my DSLR camera without the telescope attached, as I was busy showing the moon to the others. But as soon as the crescent became invisible through the optical aid, I quickly switched to my DSLR, aligned it toward the telescope’s direction, did a quick calculation, and captured several images. Alhamdulillah, the crescent was found in many of those images after a bit of post-processing. Earlier in the day, I had also captured the moon at 09:09:26 (UTC+0) with my astro camera during daylight. In total, I spent three nights on the road and covered approximately 1100 km for this moon chase. At my observing location, the moon’s altitude at sunset was +5.48°. When I first saw it, it was at +3.31° and descended to +2.46° by the time it disappeared, giving me a viewing window of only +0.85°. Without precise focus and accurate calculations, I’m certain I would not have seen the moon. If the lower sky had been clear below +2.46°, I could have observed it for longer and shared the sight with more people nearby. But very happy to see it for 6 minutes and able to capture it with a DSLR. "

Equipment and Instrumentation * Primary Optics: Seestar S30 Smart Telescope. * Mounting: Standard field tripod setup for automated tracking and stabilization. * Imaging System: Integrated digital sensor within the smart telescope system, optimized for astrophotography. 3. Environmental and Sky Conditions * Atmospheric Condition: Clear sky conditions near the western horizon, providing an optimal window for observation. * Sky Visibility: The post-sunset horizon exhibited a prominent twilight gradient featuring vibrant orange and pink hues, which provided sufficient contrast to capture the faint crescent. 4. Observation Results and Analysis * Hilal Status: Successfully Detected and Captured. * Visual Appearance: The new crescent moon (Waxing Crescent) was clearly recorded at 18:04 local time. Due to the observatory's location near the equator, the crescent exhibits a distinct "smile-like" or U-shaped orientation, with both horns pointing symmetrically upwards. * Characteristics: The lunar crescent is exceptionally thin, indicating a very low illumination percentage typical of a freshly born moon at the start of the Islamic calendar month. "

observer_notes: "I arrived at my sighting location (the Blacksburg Middle School) before sunset (sunset: 8:17 pm EDT). Using a pair of binoculars (7X50), I scanned the partly cloudy and hazy western horizon. My first binocular sighting was at 7:49 pm (about 28 minutes before sunset). Soon, the crescent disappeared behind the clouds. Later, a friend joined me to sight the moon. Our first naked eye sighting was almost an hour later than the initial optical aided sighting, when the moon reappeared in a clearing. The horns were approximately at 2:30 and 6:30 O'clock (2:30;4:30;6:30). We left the area prior to moonset when the moon set behind the clouds covering the lower part of the horizon (moonset: 9:25 pm). "

observer_notes: "On Wednesday 25th March 2020, I went out for exercise and on the route, I decided to stop to see the sunset before 6:30 pm which was a beautiful scene MashaAllah (and prayed Maghrib afterwards). The western horizon above sunset was very bright and hazy with the glare of the sun and even though I could see Venus at 6:45 pm with the naked eye, I could not see the crescent moon (Hilal) with binoculars (20x80). However, at 7:02 pm I was able to see the very thin Hilal with binoculars and was hoping to see it with the naked eye within 10-15 minutes (as I wear glasses), but it was very close to the horizon and disappeared behind distant trees after 7:15 pm before I could see it by the naked eye. Unfortunately, the location was not perfect for such a thin Hilal for naked-eye sighting (RGO/Yallop Code B) due to high light pollutions/haze (and coronavirus pandemic restrictions). Fortunately, many of our ICOUK members from other UK cities were able to see the Hilal with the naked eye, Alhamdulillah."

observer_notes: "At my home location, the sky was heavily overcast on the evening of observation, making any attempt to observe the Moon impossible. For this reason, I decided to drive approximately one hour to a higher-altitude location after checking a cloud radar app, which indicated clearer conditions in that area. Once on site, I began a targeted search for the new crescent Moon. However, the atmospheric conditions were not ideal. The seeing was poor, with noticeable atmospheric turbulence and strong air shimmer, which significantly reduced image stability and contrast. Due to this atmospheric disturbance, it was necessary to apply strong histogram stretching in order to extract the very faint crescent signal from the background. Despite these challenging conditions, I was ultimately able to detect and confirm the new crescent Moon using an astronomical camera in combination with a red filter."

The first sighting report was in Sibutu, in Tawi-Tawi province, which is the southernmost town in the country. The second one was made in Bongao, the provincial capital of the province. observer_notes: "The weather was bad in the lowlands, so we went to the local mountains in the afternoon, where conditions were excellent. The sky was dark blue right next to the sun. We setup a small mobile instrument on the site, among other visitors and grazing cattle. As expected, the view of the crescent did not change at conjunction. The sun was shining, the view was nice, all the instruments worked fine, the crescent was easy to see and the automatic software did most of the work, so i had time to play with the kids and keep the cattle away. As the weather got worse later and the moon was to set before the sun anyway, we ended the observation, got some food and left the site to the cattle again."

observer_notes: "The observation of the young crescent after sunset was difficult as we had a lot of clouds. I could see Venus for a few seconds before sunset, but the crescent remained hidden. At sunset the proper spot in the sky was covered in clouds, only a very narrow band on the horizon remained clear. I had set up an imaging system with a small lens so i would know when and where the crescent reached the gap. When the crescent appeared it was very faint and only barely visible in 12x50 binoculars as the imaging system showed me exactly where to look. I could only see it visually for a few minutes but the imaging system could follow it till it had set. So despite difficult weather conditions and a small lag time this was a visual observation after sunset."

observer_notes: "إن رؤية الهلال الشرعية عند غروب شمس يوم السبت 29 رمضان مستحبلة علميا وعمليا في جميع أقطار الأمة العربية والإسلامية ولا يرى الرؤية الشرعية إلا في أمريكا ولذا فإن يوم الأحد هو 30 رمضان ولا يمكن أن يكون يوم عيد . . وإن فتوى توحيد المطالع حديثة وهي تخالف المعيار الشرعي لإدخال الشهر وتخالف العلم الثابت الصحيح وتخالف إجماع الأمة السابق : (( فقد ذكر أبو عمرو بن عبد البر وابن عربي المالكي الإجماع على أنه لا تراعى الرؤية فيما بعد من البلدان كالأندلس من خراسان... قال: ولكل بلد رؤيتهم )) .. وقال : أجمعوا على أنه لا تعم كل أقطار الأرض . ولا يجوز شرعا مخالفة الإجماع الأول . واستدلالهم بالحديث ( صوموا لرؤيته وأفطروا لرؤيته ... ) استدلال باطل لأن فهمهم له غير صحيح يرد عليه حديث كريب الذي رواه الإمام مسلم وهو صريح في أن لكل قطر رؤيتهم . ولم يرد في السنة ولا في السيرة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أو الخلفاء الراشدين ألزم الناس برؤية أناس أبعد من مسافة القصر .... وبه قال كثير من الفقهاء .وحديث كريب صحيح وفيه أمر الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم بعدم اتباع رؤية البعيد كما بين أهل المدينة وأهل الشام ..... وبه قال كثير من العلماء قالوا إذا رؤي ببلد لزم أهل ذلك البلد وكل بلدة تقرب منه فإن قرب فالحكم واحد ، وإن بعد فلأهل كل بلد رؤيتهم ، روي هذا عن عكرمة والقاسم وسالم ، وروي عن ابن عباس ، وبه قال إسحاق ، وإليه أشار البخاري حيث بوب : [لأهل كل بلد رؤيتهم] وروى المدنيون عن مالك أن الرؤية لا تلزم بالخبر عند أهل البلد الذي وقعت فيه الرؤية ، إلا أن يكون الإمام يحمل الناس على ذلك ، وبه قال ابن الماجشون والمغيرة من أصحاب مالك . وقال ابن رشد : (( إن البلاد إذا لم تختلف مطالعها كل الاختلاف فيجب أن يحمل بعضها على بعض لأنها في قياس الأفق الواحد . وأما إذا اختلفت اختلافا كثيرا فليس يجب أن يحمل بعضها على بعض )) . كما أن فتوى توحيد المطالع تجعل عدة شهر رمضان دائما 29 يوما ولا يكون 30 يوما أبدا وهذا أيضا مخالف للنصوص الشرعية الثابتة الصحيحة وتخالف إجماع الأمة . ووهذا ما قرر فهمه كبار العلماء المحققين كالإمام القرافي والإمام النووي ..... وقد أجمع علماؤنا على أن من رأى الهلال يقينا في أول رمضان رؤية شرعية ولم تقبل شهادته ولم يصم الناس من الغد لعدم اكتمال الشهادة فإنه يجب عليه الصوم ولو أفطر للزمه القضاء والكفارة . وهذه الفتوى دالة دلالة قاطعة على وجود وجواز الخلاف في الصوم ولو في مكان واحد ... قال الإمام القرافي المالكي في كتابه الفروق : (( وإذا كان الهلال يختلف باختلاف الآفاق وجب أن يكون لكل قوم رؤيتهم في الأهلة كما أن لكل قوم فجرهم وغير ذلك من أوقات الصلوات وهذا حق ظاهر وصواب متعين أما وجوب الصوم على جميع الأقاليم برؤية الهلال بقطر منها فبعيد عن القواعد والأدلة لم تقتض ذلك فاعلمه...)). وهناك تفصيل أن كل رؤية لا تعضدها الرؤية بالعين المجردة فهي رؤية غير شرعية"

observer_notes: "I arrived at my sighting location around sunset (sunset: 8:46 pm EDT). The western horizon was partly cloudy. Using a pair of binoculars (7X50), I started scanning the horizon, hoping to see the crescent in the openings. After a few minutes, a friend of mine and his son joined me; he was using a pair of 10X50 binoculars. The first binocular sighting was at 9:06 pm. The crescent was very thin and by that time close to the horizon. The horns were at about 2:00 and 7:00 O'clock (2:00;4:30;7:00). We continued our sighting till 9:10 pm when the moon was no longer visible and perhaps setting behind the distant mountains (moonset: 9:21 pm). I did not try naked eye sighting since the time was very short and perhaps very difficult if not impossible to sight the crescent without binoculars."

observer_notes: "رُؤِيَ الهلال بكل سهولة وهو أمر متوقع لأنه هلال إكمال العدة يجب أن يرى بكل وضوح وسهولة وإلا فإدخال أول الشهر يكون خطأ . وهاك بيان ذلك : . إن الرؤية الشرعية الصادقة والطرق العلمية الصحيحة والطرق التجريبية الملموسة ... تفيدنا أن هلال إكمال العدة ( أي ليلة إحدى وثلاثين أو قُلْ عند غروب شمس يوم ثلاثين من الشهر القمري ) يكون كبيرا واضحا لا يخفى عن أحد في اليوم الصحو . لأنه هلال تولد منذ أكثر من 24 ساعة وأحيانا أكثر بكثير ... والإمام مالك رحمه الله نصحنا بالتثبت في آخر الشهر فقال : (( إذا كانت ليلة إحدى وثلاثين صحوا ولم يُرَ الهلال لا يجوز الفطر غدا ويجب صومه وتكذب الشهادة على دخول الشهر , لأن هلال إكمال العدة لا يخفى عن أحد )) , أي أنه يرى بكل سهولة . لأنه دائما يكون حجمه كبيرا . وقد قال ابن تيمية مثل ذلك في مجموع الفتاوى ج: 25 ص: 185 قال : (( فمعرفة الكسوف والخسوف لمن صح حسابه مثل معرفة كل أحد أن ليلة الحادي والثلاثين من الشهر لابد أن يطلع الهلال وإنما يقع الشك ليلة الثلاثين )) . يعني أن هلال إكمال العدة يُرَى ليلة الحادي والثلاثين من الشهر قطعا بلا شك ، ويستحيل خفاؤه ، فلا بد أن يطلع ويرى عند إمام الأئمة مالك وعند ابن تيمية ... وإلا فالشهادة على دخول أول الشهر الحالي باطلة بوجه من الوجوه . . وإكمال الصوم واجب على الجميع في آخر رمضان . وأمر الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم صريح في ذلك ولكن الكثيرين لم ينتبهوا له ، وبيانه كما يلي : 1°) علق رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلاًّ من الصيام والفطر ، على حد سواء ، على رؤية الهلال الرؤية الشرعية ليس إلا . وهي الرؤية الممكنة لكل من كان مع من يراه ، وليست الرؤية التي يراها الخصوص دون العموم . فقد قال : (( صُومُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَأَفْطِرُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ )) البخاري ومسلم والترمذي والنسائي وابن ماجة وأحمد والدارمي ... وقال : (( لَا تَصُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوُا الْهِلَالَ وَلَا تُفْطِرُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ )) رواه مالك والبخاري ومسلم والنسائي وأبو داود وأحمد والدارمي ... فقول الرسول () (( لِرُؤْيَتِهِ )) نفهم منه الرؤية الممكنة . وقول الرسول () (( حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ )) نفهم منه تعميم الرؤية الممكنة ولا يجوز تخصيصها وإلا لقبلناها من رؤية النائم أو من أهل الكشف أو من الحساب بلا شرط ..... فرؤية الهلال الرؤية الشرعية الصحيحة لا يخفى معها الهلال في اليوم الصحو أبدا . وإلا لما سميت رؤية هلال أصلا . فخفاء الهلال في اليوم الصحو يعني عدم وجوده وعدم ولادته أصلا . فإن كان ذلك ليلة إحدى وثلاثين فهو دليل قاطع على فساد إدخال الشهر الحالي . ولا يجوز العدول عن التماس رؤية الهلال في اليوم الصحو إلى الاكتفاء بإكمال العدة ثلاثين يوما فقط . لأن العدول عن التماس رؤية الهلال إلى إكمال العدة ثلاثين يوما مشروط لسبب عارض فقط من غيم أو مطر أو ضباب أو شدة غبار أو رياح ثائرة ... وهو واضح في كل تلك الأحاديث الصحيحة : قال رسول الله ص : (( لَا تَصُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوُا الْهِلَالَ وَلَا تُفْطِرُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْدُرُوا لَهُ )) رواه مالك والبخاري ومسلم والنسائي وأبو داود وأحمد والدارمي ... وفي رواية لأحمد (( ... فَإِنْ خَفِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَتِمُّوا ثَلَاثِينَ )) وفي رواية (( ... فَإِنْ غَبِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَعُدُّوا ثَلَاثِينَ )) . وفي رواية (( ... فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَكْمِلُوا الْعِدَّةَ ثَلَاثِينَ )) وفي رواية (( ... فَإِنْ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْدِرُوا لَهُ )) . أما إذا انتفى السبب العارض فتعليق كُلاًّ من الصيام والفطر باق على أصل أمر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من رؤية الهلال الرؤية الشرعية ليس إلا . ولو أدى ذلك إلى صوم أكثر من ثلاثين يوما . لأن العبرة بالحق والواقع لا بالشهادة التي يجب إسقاطها إذا بان الحق . وهذا ما تفطن إليه إمام الأئمة مالك رحمه الله تعالى ..... فافهم وسلم تفلح وتغنم ... ولأن صحة الشهادة كانت متوفرة عندما كانت الشهادة شهادة حق أما بعد القرون الثلاثة الأولى فلا . خاصة وأنه قد ظهر في المسلمين كثيرون من انتسبوا للعلم والعلماء ، وما كانوا إلا وبالا على الأمة في دينها ودنياها ومنهم من ثبت بالتحقيق أنه مدلس أو وضاع أو يخبط خبط عشواء أو مفتر كذاب منتصر لما يهواه ... وهم في عهدنا هذا أكثر بكثير ... وقد روى الترمذي عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ : (( خَطَبَنَا عُمَرُ بِالْجَابِيَةِ فَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي قُمْتُ فِيكُمْ كَمَقَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهم عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِينَا فَقَالَ أُوصِيكُمْ بِأَصْحَابِي ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَفْشُو الْكَذِبُ حَتَّى يَحْلِفَ الرَّجُلُ وَلَا يُسْتَحْلَفُ وَيَشْهَدَ الشَّاهِدُ وَلَا يُسْتَشْهَدُ .)) حديث حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ وَقَدْ رَوَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ مِنْ غَيْرِ وَجْهٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهم عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ * ففي عصرنا هذا لا يجوز التساهل في قبول شهادة الشهود بدون قرائن تدعمها . وخاصة في أمر رؤية الهلال الذي تطرأ عليها كثير من التخيلات والأوهام كما بيناه . بل كثير من الناس يتعمدون الكذب في ادعاء الرؤية ، انتصارا لفئة ما أو بلد ما ... فويل لهم ثم ويل لهم عند ربهم . والدليل على أمثال ذلك ملموس من الواقع ، فهلال إكمال العدة بالنسبة للسعودية غالبا غير موجود أصلا ، وإن وجد مرة فلا أحد يصدق أنه هلال إكمال العدة لدقته وصعوبة رؤيته . ( بل كثيرا ما لا نرى حتى هلال ابن ليلتين المزعوم من السعودية رغم صفاء السماء ) وهذا أكبر وأوضح دليل معلوم على بطلان منهجهم في إثبات الأهلة في الصيام والحج وغيرهما ، وستأتيك تفاصيل وتقارير أخرى بإذن الله تعالى ... فانظر إلى إمام الأئمة مالك وما أدراك كيف يحكم على الرؤية بأنها ظنية غير قطعية وأنه إذا وجد أمر قطعي يكذب الرؤية فيجب الإعتماد عليه . كهلال إكمال العدة ونحن اليوم عندنا الحساب من الأمور القطعية التي يجب الإعتماد عليها لتصديق الرؤية أو تكذيبها على الأقل . وهذا قال به فقهاء كثيرون معتبرون .... ولكن يجب أن يكون القائمين بالحساب أناس أكفاء أمناء صادقين لا يحرفونه عن حقيقته كما هو حال أغلب الدول الإسلامية { للجهل بمعايير رؤية الهلال أو لأغراض سياسية أو اقتصادية أو طائفية أو حتى شخصية أحيانا ... } فقد أوردت الجمعيّة الفلكيّة الأردنية التي تترأس المشروع الإسلامي لرصد الأهلّة : أن نسبة الخطأ في تحديد هلال رمضان في بعض البلدان العربية والإسلامية يفوق 90%...ا.هـ . وأما في السعودية فالخطأ يقارب 100 % ... وكم من العلماء والأئمة الصادقين الذين أرسلوا إلى السعودية يحذرونها من أخطائها في إدخال شهر رمضان وشهر ذي الحجة وأنها بذلك تفسد على الناس حجهم وصومهم كما قرره الفقهاء ولكنها لا تبالي جهلا وجمودا وعنادا واستكبارا . "

والدارمي ... وفي رواية لأحمد (( ... فَإِنْ خَفِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَتِمُّوا ثَلَاثِينَ )) وفي رواية (( ... فَإِنْ غَبِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَعُدُّوا ثَلَاثِينَ )) . وفي رواية (( ... فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَكْمِلُوا الْعِدَّةَ ثَلَاثِينَ )) وفي رواية (( ... فَإِنْ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْدِرُوا لَهُ )) . أما إذا انتفى السبب العارض فتعليق كُلاًّ من الصيام والفطر باق على أصل أمر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من رؤية الهلال الرؤية الشرعية ليس إلا . ولو أدى ذلك إلى صوم أكثر من ثلاثين يوما . لأن العبرة بالحق والواقع لا بالشهادة التي يجب إسقاطها إذا بان الحق . وهذا ما تفطن إليه إمام الأئمة مالك رحمه الله تعالى ..... فافهم وسلم تفلح وتغنم ... ولأن صحة الشهادة كانت متوفرة عندما كانت الشهادة شهادة حق أما بعد القرون الثلاثة الأولى فلا . خاصة وأنه قد ظهر في المسلمين كثيرون من انتسبوا للعلم والعلماء ، وما كانوا إلا وبالا على الأمة في دينها ودنياها ومنهم من ثبت بالتحقيق أنه مدلس أو وضاع أو يخبط خبط عشواء أو مفتر كذاب منتصر لما يهواه ... وهم في عهدنا هذا أكثر بكثير ... وقد روى الترمذي عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ : (( خَطَبَنَا عُمَرُ بِالْجَابِيَةِ فَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي قُمْتُ فِيكُمْ كَمَقَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهم عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِينَا فَقَالَ أُوصِيكُمْ بِأَصْحَابِي ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَفْشُو الْكَذِبُ حَتَّى يَحْلِفَ الرَّجُلُ وَلَا يُسْتَحْلَفُ وَيَشْهَدَ الشَّاهِدُ وَلَا يُسْتَشْهَدُ .)) حديث حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ وَقَدْ رَوَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ مِنْ غَيْرِ وَجْهٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهم عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ * ففي عصرنا هذا لا يجوز التساهل في قبول شهادة الشهود بدون قرائن تدعمها . وخاصة في أمر رؤية الهلال الذي تطرأ عليها كثير من التخيلات والأوهام كما بيناه . بل كثير من الناس يتعمدون الكذب في ادعاء الرؤية ، انتصارا لفئة ما أو بلد ما ... فويل لهم ثم ويل لهم عند ربهم . والدليل على أمثال ذلك ملموس من الواقع ، فهلال إكمال العدة بالنسبة للسعودية غالبا غير موجود أصلا ، وإن وجد مرة فلا أحد يصدق أنه هلال إكمال العدة لدقته وصعوبة رؤيته . ( بل كثيرا ما لا نرى حتى هلال ابن ليلتين المزعوم من السعودية رغم صفاء السماء ) وهذا أكبر وأوضح دليل معلوم على بطلان منهجهم في إثبات الأهلة في الصيام والحج وغيرهما ، وستأتيك تفاصيل وتقارير أخرى بإذن الله تعالى ... فانظر إلى إمام الأئمة مالك وما أدراك كيف يحكم على الرؤية بأنها ظنية غير قطعية وأنه إذا وجد أمر قطعي يكذب الرؤية فيجب الإعتماد عليه . كهلال إكمال العدة ونحن اليوم عندنا الحساب من الأمور القطعية التي يجب الإعتماد عليها لتصديق الرؤية أو تكذيبها على الأقل . وهذا قال به فقهاء كثيرون معتبرون .... ولكن يجب أن يكون القائمين بالحساب أناس أكفاء أمناء صادقين لا يحرفونه عن حقيقته كما هو حال أغلب الدول الإسلامية { للجهل بمعايير رؤية الهلال أو لأغراض سياسية أو اقتصادية أو طائفية أو حتى شخصية أحيانا ... } فقد أوردت الجمعيّة الفلكيّة الأردنية التي تترأس المشروع الإسلامي لرصد الأهلّة : أن نسبة الخطأ في تحديد هلال رمضان في بعض البلدان العربية والإسلامية يفوق 90%...ا.هـ . وأما في السعودية فالخطأ يقارب 100 % ... وكم من العلماء والأئمة الصادقين الذين أرسلوا إلى السعودية يحذرونها من أخطائها في إدخال شهر رمضان وشهر ذي الحجة وأنها بذلك تفسد على الناس حجهم وصومهم كما قرره الفقهاء ولكنها لا تبالي جهلا وجمودا وعنادا واستكبارا . "

observer_notes: "Old Moon Crescent Observation Report ====================================== Observed: Friday; June 23, 2017 - 05:34 (Local) Location (WGS 84) = Tucson, Arizona (USA) Longitude = 110.9651 W Latitude = 32.4206 N Elevation = 842 meters Time Zone = -7.0 hours Surface conditions at location: Temperature = 28 °C Humidity = 46 % Pressure = 29.65 in. Significant cloud buildup began before observation time, and I was only given about 1 minute to observe as the moon rose over Pusch Ridge. Topocentric and local time values from “Accurate Times”: Moonrise (at sea level) = 04:55 Sunrise (at sea level) = 05:12 Time from new moon at 05:34 = 15 hr. 08 min. Moon lag time = 17 min. Relative Altitude = 3.3 degrees Elongation from sun = 9.0 degrees Crescent width = 12 arc seconds Illumination = 0.6 percent I was NOT able to see the crescent, even through a telescope. This was a special effort because NASA had reported a recent burning off of the invisible cloud layer that was responsible for noctilucent clouds. I suspected that this invisible layer was the reason for so many previous negative observations. I was encouraged by the easy sighting of a 6th magnitude star at 04:34 (5° altitude with 50x thru the 20 cm scope). Observer: Jim Stamm E-mail Address: [email protected] "

observer_notes: "I arrived at my sighting location at 7:41 pm EDT (sunset: 8:31 pm; apparent sunset: 8:20 pm). The western horizon was mostly clear and very hazy. Using a pair of binoculars (7X50), I started scanning the horizon. I spotted Venus at 8:12 pm with the pair of binoculars; later, Venus was clearly visible with naked eye at 8:36 pm. The first binocular sighting of the crescent moon was at about 8:38 pm. The crescent was thin and was visible with the naked eye at 8:47 pm. The horns were approximately at 2:30 and 6:30 O'clock (2:30;4:30;6:30). A friend of mine was also able to see the crescent, using a pair of (10X50) binoculars and then with naked eye. The first sighting of Mercury was at 8:42 pm. Later, mercury was also clearly visible with naked eye. I changed my location and stayed at the new site till moon set at 9:24 pm (moonset: 9:35 pm; apparent moonset 9:24 pm)."

observer_notes: "Several of us were at our sighting location before sunset (sunset: 8:21 pm EDT). With prior knowledge of the approximate position of the moon in the sky according to Stellarium software and the actual observation of Venus during the past two days, using a pair of binoculars (7X50), I started looking for the planet in small clearings. The first optical aided sighting of Venus was at 8:35 pm. In the absence of clouds, I could have sighted Venus much earlier even with naked eye as I did last evening at 8:29 pm. The size of the clearing was small and perhaps it was one of the reasons that I could not see the close-by crescent moon at that time. Thicker lower clouds made the sighting more difficult. By this time, our hope was to see the crescent prior to setting in a band of clearing hugging the horizon. In fact, that is exactly what happened; my first binocular sighting was at 9:01 pm followed by naked eye sighting a minute later. The moon's horns were approximately at 3:00 and 6:30 O'clock (3:00;5:00;6:30). It took a few minutes for the moon to disappear behind the distant mountains before the actual moonset listed for Blacksburg at 9:22 pm. By this time, all ten of us had seen the moon by naked eye. At 8:55 pm, the temperature, dew point, relative humidity, and pressure were 51.0 F, 35.0 F, 53%, and 30.27 in, respectively. "

observer_notes: "On May 1st, 2022, Assalaam observatory at the Islamic Boarding School of Assalaam (Sukoharjo, Central Java, Indonesia) organized crescent observation (ru'ya hilaal) for determining the beginning of Shawwal 1443 AH. The observation team was led by the head of the observatory, Mr. AR Sugeng Riyadi. The team member list is Mr. Purnomo, Mr. Taufiq, Mrs. Ratna and Ms. Sendy. Several invited guests also attended the events including reporters from media, alumni and guardian of Assalaam students. The Ash-Shi'ra Observatory at MAN 1 Surakarta also organized the crescent observation. Their team was led by Mrs. Nurul and Mr. Faisal. The crescent was not sighted due to the complete cloud covers in the western sky at Surakarta City. However, according to the neo-MABIMS criterion and naked eye reports from other locations in Indonesia, the Itsbat Council by Ministry of Religious Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia declared that the 1st of Shawwal 1443 AH in Indonesia will start on Monday, 2nd of May 2022."

observer_notes: "السماء كانت صافية وفيها بعض الغيوم فقط ومكان تواجد الهلال ( حسب ما نعلمه جيدا بالحسابات الفلكية الدقيقة ) صافية ويعتريها بعض الغيم أحيانا ومع ذلك لم أتمكن من رؤية الهلال لا بالعين المجردة ولا بالمنظار ولو كان اليوم هو 30 رمضان لما خفي الهلال عن أحد في مثل هذه الظروف لأن هلال إكمال العدة لا يخفى عن أحد ويرى بالعين المجردة بكل سهولة لأنه يجب أن يكون سميكا ومرتفعا لا يخفى . ( فما بالك بهلال ابن ليلتين ) وإلا فإن إدخال الشهر باطل لاسـتحالة المشــهود به . والشرع لا يأتي بالمســتحيلات. ففي تبصرة الحكام لابن فرحون اليعمري: «قال أصحابنا: إذا شهد شاهدان في الصَّحْوِ في المِصر الكبير على هلال رمضان ولم يَرَهُ غيرُهما، قال سَحْنونٌ: هما شاهِدا سوءٍ، فإذا قُبِلا فعُدّ ثلاثون يوماً ولم يُرَ الهلالُ والسّماء مُصْحِيَةٌ، قال مالكٌ: هما شاهِدا سوءٍ، لأنّ ذلك قرينةٌ ظاهرةٌ في كذِبهما». فالإمام مالك رحمه الله نصحنا بالتثبت في آخر الشهر فقال : (( إذا كانت ليلة إحدى وثلاثين صحوا ولم يُرَ الهلال لا يجوز الفطر غدا ويجب صومه وتُكَذَّبُ الشهادة على دخول الشهر , لأن هلال إكمال العدة لا يخفى عن أحد )) , أي أنه يرى بكل سهولة . لأنه دائما يكون حجمه كبيرا . وحتى ابن تيمية قال مثل ذلك في مجموع الفتاوى ج: 25 ص: 185 قال : (( فمعرفة الكسوف والخسوف لمن صح حسابه مثل معرفة كل أحد أن ليلة الحادي والثلاثين من الشهر لابد أن يطلع الهلال وإنما يقع الشك ليلة الثلاثين )) . يعني أن هلال إكمال العدة يُرَى ليلة الحادي والثلاثين من الشهر قطعا بلا شك ، ويستحيل خفاؤه ، فلا بد أن يطلع ويرى عند إمام الأئمة مالك وعند ابن تيمية ... وإلا فالشهادة على دخول أول الشهر الحالي باطلة بوجه من الوجوه . . وإكمال الصوم واجب على الجميع في آخر رمضان ... وكذلك قال الإمام العلامة والمجتهد السبكي ..."

observer_notes: "To avoid possible cloud cover interference with my crescent sighting, I travelled to the town of Abingdon, VA, over 100 miles to the southwest of Blacksburg. At 8:58 pm, the crescent was behind a piece of cloud hugging the distant mountains (moonset: 9:20 pm). While in Abingdon, my friends in two groups of one and three also sighted the moon with naked eyes and photographed it in Blacksburg. Three bystanders also sighted the moon along with the latter group. The first sighting in Blacksburg was at 8:41 pm."

observer_notes: "On the observation day, four individuals attempted to sight the new crescent moon (hilāl). Before sunset, the crescent was clearly detectable using CCD cameras with the aid of stacking techniques. After sunset, the crescent remained visible with CCD cameras, even without the use of stacking. However, visual observation proved to be significantly more difficult. For a prolonged period, the crescent could not be seen, neither with binoculars nor with telescopes. Approximately 15 minutes before moonset, one observer was able to sight the crescent visually for the first time. Shortly afterward, the remaining three observers were also able to see it. A confirmed naked-eye sighting remains uncertain. Two observers had the impression that they briefly saw the crescent, but they could not confirm this with full certainty."

observer_notes: "We could observe the young crescent VISUALLY after sunset for about 20 minutes, starting at 18:40 local time. We used the 7 inch refractor of the Public Observatory Munich, as only this of our instruments can reach so low to the western horizon. We aligned the instrument on planet Venus. I had attached a camera with the imaging software to the finder scope, which showed the crescent easily even before sunset. We could thus precisely bring the crescent arc into the center of the field of view. We had focused the instrument on Venus beforehand. Initially the crescent arc was very faint and short but it got longer and more prominent as the sun sank deeper. The arc clearly showed regions of differing brightness. Near the end of the observation the arc got more difficult again, as we encountered very low clouds. This is one of the narrowest crescents i have seen visually yet."

observer_notes: "REPORT ON SYAWAL 1447 H HILAL OBSERVATION (RUKYATUL HILAL) 1. Activity Overview * Event: Observation of the Syawal 1447 H New Moon (Rukyatul Hilal). * Location: Assalaam Observatory, Kartasura, Sukoharjo, Central Java. * Date: Thursday, March 19, 2026. * Time: 17:40 WIB – 18:00 WIB. 2. Astronomical Data (Hisab Results) Based on the calculations for the Assalaam Observatory location: * Sunset (Maghrib): 17:48:17 WIB. * Moonset: 17:57:38 WIB. * Moon Altitude: +2.38°. * Elongation: 5.55°. * Moon Age: 09 hours 22 minutes 15 seconds. * Criteria Analysis: The moon's position was below the Neo-MABIMS criteria (which requires a minimum altitude of 3° and an elongation of 6.4°). 3. Observation Results The observation was attended by observers and participants at the Assalaam Observatory. Despite the use of astronomical equipment and direct monitoring, the Hilal (crescent moon) was not sighted due to its low altitude and the current atmospheric conditions. 4. National Isbat Meeting (Sidang Isbat) Following the local observations, the Ministry of Religious Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia held a central Isbat meeting in Jakarta. Reports from various observation points across Indonesia consistently indicated that the Hilal could not be seen. 5. Conclusion Due to the unsuccessful sighting of the Hilal across all observation points in Indonesia, the Minister of Religious Affairs has officially declared that the month of Ramadan will be completed as 30 days (istikmal). Therefore, 1 Syawal 1447 H (Eid al-Fitr 2026) falls on Saturday, March 21, 2026. "
